scope: Fix reproduced optional original-dependency false qualification when TABLE AcDbBlockReference2 resolves to one original BLOCK_RECORD but AcDbTable343 resolves to another. Join selected original targets using frozen source context and preserve both physical fields, original target values and specific refusal reasons. This does not qualify graphical contents, full recursive/owner/live/emitted/native dependencies or a broader producer/version profile.

implementation.originalPair: TABLE parent only; linked ATTRIB/SEQEND and cell/application/XDATA lookalikes cannot supply the partner role. Name lookup uses existing original typed/raw producer-backed namespace census and conservative codec/name matching. Handle lookup uses the existing actual original target provider.
implementation.coupling: Only two independently Matched, nonzero equal original target IDs match. Preserve each row role/code/group/target and record reciprocal coupled group/target metadata. Unequal resolved targets become CoupledTargetMismatch; a matched side with an absent/unqualified partner becomes CoupledTargetUnavailable. Preserve existing wrong-kind/missing/null/name refusals.
implementation.linearAndAllocationFree: Scan only the current node rows after ordinary lookup. No join allocation or repeated whole-graph search; existing row-size accounting includes new private metadata. Query controls reach allocation-failure0 without allocating.
